Characters, synopsis: Added by Per Sandell (2005-12-05). 

Timely-Atlas expert Michael Vassallo has examined hundreds of known Klein art and inking samples, as has Nick Caputo, and both agree that Klein is the primary inker, with alterations likely by Sol Brodsky.  

In the letters page of issue #281 it states according to Roz and Jack Kirby, via Steve Leialoha, that it was Artie Simek who inked the first issue of FF and that Sol Brodsky started inking with issue #2 (Brodsky actually started inking with # 3). Previous indexer credited Chris Rule as possible inker.

longest_story.first_line: Looks like we found them just in time!

longest_story.synopsis: Dr. Doom battles the Fantastic Four and Daredevil. Reed restores the team's powers with the Stimulator (which was introduced in issue #37). Ben is returned to being The Thing, crushes Doom's hands and drives him off, wounded. Ben deserts the Fantastic Four.

longest_story.first_line: Last month we saw the F.F. defeat Dr. Doom!

longest_story.first_line: Torch! Lower your flame, you juvenile incompetent!
longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Girl [Susan Storm]; Mister Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Frightful Four [Madam Medusa [Medusalith Amaquelin Boltagon]; Sandman [Flint Marko]; Trapster [Peter Petruski]; Wizard [Bentley Wittman]]; Doctor Doom [Victor Von Doom]; Sgt. longest_story.first_line: Quick, Johnny! Grab my hands...

longest_story.title: Those Who Would Destroy Us!
longest_story.first_line: He's as dangerous as I feared!
longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Girl [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; The Inhumans [Black Bolt [Blackagar Boltagon]; Crystal [Crystalia Amaquelin Maximoff]; Gorgon; Karnak; Lockjaw; Medusa [Medusalith Amaquelin Boltagon]; Triton]; Dragon Man; Seeker (first appearance)
longest_story.synopsis: The FF battle the Inhumans.  Triton is captured by the Seeker and the Inhumans teleport away.  The FF are captured by the Seeker as they attempt to free Triton.

longest_story.title: Beware the Hidden Land!
longest_story.first_line: The Inhumans are gone!
longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Girl [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; The Inhumans [Black Bolt [Blackagar Boltagon]; Crystal [Crystalia Amaquelin Maximoff]; Gorgon; Karnak; Lockjaw; Medusa [Medusalith Amaquelin Boltagon]; Triton]; Dragon Man; Alicia Masters; Maximus (first appearance); Seeker; Alpha Primitives (first appearance)
longest_story.synopsis: After subduing Dragon Man, the FF follow the Inhumans to their Great Refuge.

longest_story.title: The Coming of Galactus!
longest_story.first_line: Black Bolt's evil brother, Maximus the Magnificent, in a final, desperate attempt to regain his lost crown, has fired the dreaded atmo gun...
longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Girl [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; The Inhumans [Black Bolt [Blackagar Boltagon]; Crystal [Crystalia Amaquelin Maximoff]; Gorgon; Karnak; Medusa [Medusalith Amaquelin Boltagon]]; Galactus [Galan] (first appearance); Maximus; Seeker; Silver Surfer [Norrin Radd] (first appearance); The Watcher [Uatu]; Skrulls
longest_story.synopsis: Black Bolt and the Fantastic Four put an end to Maximus's plan to destroy all the humans. Once the Fantastic Four return to New York the Watcher tells them of the coming danger of Galactus.
longest_story.notes:
Kirby's co-plotting credit is acknowledged by Lee and Kirby in many interviews.  Actual credits read "Stan Lee, writer without peer  Jack Kirby penciller of the year."

This is the first issue of the three-part story which introduces Galactus and the Silver Surfer.

longest_story.first_line: Galactus has landed on Earth!

longest_story.synopsis: The Fantastic Four try to slow Galactus while the Watcher takes the Human Torch to find a weapon to defeat Galactus. Alicia Masters convinces Silver Surfer to help humanity.
longest_story.notes:
Kirby's co-plotting is acknowledged by Lee and Kirby in many interviews.  The credits read:  "Written in the masterful manner of Stan Lee  Illustrated in the magnificent mode of Jack Kirby."

The Punisher character in this issue is not the same as the latter Marvel hero.
